prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1245; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain and restricted cervical range of motion. The reported injury is consistent in type and mechanism with the force of this impact. Over the course of eleven visits, care proceeded along a typical conservative pathway, including manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise program. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was tapered as function returned.

On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical rotation were noted, supporting the presence of a soft tissue injury. Other components of the neurological and orthopedic assessment were within normal limits, with no motor deficit, no sensory change, and negative provocative testing. No prior injury or treatment involving the cervical region is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated entries.

Current assessment is cervical strain, improving. Discharge from active care is anticipated pending completion of the home program, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
